name: Cormund
title: Banker
examine: Ink-stained fingers, a banker's stoop, and the calm of a man who has counted everything he owns twice.
lines: The vault is stone, the ledger is ink, and both outlast a promise.
My father kept the ford toll in a wooden box. The year the Redmasks chained the ford, the box taught us all a lesson. The bank is that lesson, in stone.
Bursar Odele of Silverfall countersigns our charter. Her letters arrive with every caravan and are dryer than the flour Garton mills.
